_comment: Editorial content for HGFA. This symbol is a fund unit line, not an operating company: the sector label 'close-end mutual fund' in our own data is out of date. Described from the scheme's offering document only. headOffice and phone are null — the fund has no office of its own; HBL Asset Management Limited is the management company. products is empty: a scheme has no products.
description: HBL Growth Fund is an equity mutual fund managed by HBL Asset Management Limited. It was constituted in 2004 as the closed-end PICIC Growth Fund and was converted into an open-end scheme on 2 July 2018; its Class A units, issued on conversion, are a frozen class that is no longer open to fresh investment. The fund's stated objective is to maximise the wealth of unit holders by investing primarily in listed equities.
sourceNote: HBL Growth Fund Consolidated Offering Document (hblasset.com, consolidated to 8 September 2025), read 2026-10-17.
